view: Ground-level close view weathered upright Maya limestone stela at Calakmul with extremely eroded relief, jungle roots and massive Structure II lower terraces behind, low filtered light, no crisp invented inscriptions.

eras.title: Stelae in the forest
eras.caption: Calakmul was the seat of a powerful Maya dynasty. Carved stelae among its temples preserve names and events from its rulers' lives, helping archaeologists reconstruct the city's relations with other Maya kingdoms.
